card.name: Mode or mechanism before "of action"
card.fires_on: The words "mode" or "mechanism", or the "of" after them, when the next word is expected to be "action". Seen in drug-label phrases like "mechanism of action" and "mode of action".

modes.label: Mechanism before of action
modes.description: The word "mechanism" after "Based on its" or "Due to its" in warnings.
modes.example: 5.10 Embryo-Fetal Toxicity Based on its<< mechanism>> of action and findings from animal studies,

modes.label: Mode in similarities
modes.description: The word "mode" in "similarities in mode of action", or the "of" that follows it.
modes.example: in view of their close similarities in<< mode>> of action and chemical structure.

modes.label: Of after mode
modes.description: The word "of" after "mode" where "action" or "administration" is likely to follow.
modes.example: The pharmacologic properties of ZOLADEX and its mode<< of>> administration make accidental or intentional overdosage

card.writes: It pushes the model to write the word "action" next.
card.plain: It lights up when a label says "mechanism of" or "mode of" and the word "action" is about to come.
